description: Create or update a workspace lead source: set its label and active state by key (built-in or custom, lowercase_with_underscores). Idempotent — re-sending the same key updates it. Archiving the fallback 'other' source is not allowed. Use list_lead_sources to see current sources. The result echoes the operating workspace.

isActive.description: Whether the source is selectable for new leads. Set false to archive it (the fallback 'other' source cannot be archived).

key.description: Stable source key, lowercase_with_underscores (built-in or custom).

label.description: Human-readable label shown for this source in the UI.

name: set_lead_sources
title: Set lead source
